# Flag Images

Source identified by the user: Flagpedia.net.

- Terms: https://flagpedia.net/terms
- Vector download information: https://flagpedia.net/download/vector
- Checked: 2026-10-18

Flagpedia states that its flag images are public domain and may be used freely.
Its vector download page explicitly permits commercial and non-commercial use
and identifies Wikimedia Commons vector files as the basis of the collection.
These statements concern the flag images, not Flagpedia's text, website design,
code or other graphics. Flagpedia appreciates a backlink; the cited pages do not
state that attribution is mandatory for use of the flag images.

The 254 local SVG assets were supplied by the user and copied without modification.
Their hashes are recorded in data/flags-manifest.json. Their exact correspondence
to a current upstream release has not been independently established. Do not label
the artwork with an invented SPDX license identifier or relicense it as component code.

The component's code license is separate from the status of these third-party assets.
# Continent Classification

## Geographic Observations

Structured population observations are attributed to Our World in Data,
https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/population, using UN World Population Prospects
2024 continental aggregates for reference year 2023. OWID data is provided under
CC BY 4.0 subject to its original data-source terms. Source snapshot checksum
and per-observation citations are retained in `data/continent-facts.json`.
Geographic facts cite their original scientific, government, educational or
encyclopedic source individually. Reference notes are original summaries, not
reproduced article text. Area, river-length and lake-size conventions differ;
the supplied values retain scope/measurement caveats rather than asserting a
single universally applicable geographic definition.

Country-to-continent assignments use the `Continent` field from
https://github.com/datasets/country-codes, derived from GeoNames:
https://www.geonames.org/ (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
The generated world seed retains the source checksum. Names and ISO identifiers
remain from the separately attributed iso-codes catalogue. Selected
transcontinental countries have additional geographic memberships; Kosovo and
UK sporting territories have explicitly classified European membership.
Geographic grouping is not a statement about sovereignty.
